Role Description
This is a full-time, on-site Job in Baia Mare for a Software Developer .
The Software Developer will participate in the process of developing , testing , and maintaining software applications for embedded systems , servers , and user interfaces .
 Required Qualifications
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 Excellent understanding of software concepts
 Excellent understanding of algorithms and data structures
 Excellent understanding of software architecture and design
 Excellent knowledge of at least one of the following programming languages: C/C++ or Python (knowledge of both languages is a plus)
 Minimum experience level for this role: Mid-Level / Intermediate Developer
 Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
 Knowledge of the Linux command line
 Knowledge of the PHP programming language and creating web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus
 Experience with embedded systems and/or development
 Experience with server applications and/or user interfaces
 Experience with creating unit and integration tests
 Problem-solving skills
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills
 Benefits
 Professional and dynamic work environment
 Training and professional development opportunities
 Increasing number of vacation days based on company seniority
 Company Description
 Binar Electronics specializes in developing custom hardware and software solutions , tailored to the specific needs of our clients. We offer complete solutions , from concept and prototyping to the final product ready for field deployment. With over 9 years of experience in PCB design and manufacturing and software development, we deliver innovative and high-quality solutions for various industries.
